## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and bounded scope. Link the claimed issue and identify any shared files coordinated with other contributors.

## Evidence and checks

Give the checked revision, commands, outcomes and public evidence paths. Mark checks not run and explain why. Report public compilation, exact object matching, real source linking, bounded behavior, independent replay and platform execution separately where relevant. State remaining limitations and requested source credit; coordinator review is required for acceptance.

## Review

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change focused.
- [ ] Source or naming changes preserve canonical identities, dependencies, embedded strings and layout; relevant declarations and uses are updated together.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff, logs and artifacts for original game payloads, hybrid images, keys, saves and credentials; none are included.
- [ ] I recorded partial work and remaining questions on the linked issue instead of closing an incomplete task.

For publication, report the committed-tree/history audit result from `toolscripts/publication_audit.py`. Public source compilation does not establish original-byte matching or a complete game.
